g.text: Footprints for the exact LEDs and switch are intentionally blank pending their physical pad audit.

g.desc: Footprints for the exact LEDs and switch are intentionally blank pending their physical pad audit.

g.text: Send black before storage. Respect the system power/current budget in firmware.

g.desc: Send black before storage. Respect the system power/current budget in firmware.

g.text: RGB chain: exact WS2812C-2020-V6 on shared nominal +3V3. Below 3.3 V operation is not guaranteed.

g.desc: RGB chain: exact WS2812C-2020-V6 on shared nominal +3V3. Below 3.3 V operation is not guaranteed.

g.text: Prototype gate: scope startup, low battery, Wi-Fi and full-white transitions at the LEDs; verify shared peak capacity.

g.desc: Prototype gate: scope startup, low battery, Wi-Fi and full-white transitions at the LEDs; verify shared peak capacity.

g.text: Always-on bias and capacitive loading need application qualification.

g.desc: Always-on bias and capacitive loading need application qualification.

g.text: Alps side push, 2.2 N. Common pairs: 1-2 and 3-4.

g.desc: Alps side push, 2.2 N. Common pairs: 1-2 and 3-4.

g.text: Both LED control outputs default low. Current is limited by 2.2k per die.

g.desc: Both LED control outputs default low. Current is limited by 2.2k per die.

g.text: 100k / 100nF gives about 10 ms debounce; firmware must also debounce.

g.desc: 100k / 100nF gives about 10 ms debounce; firmware must also debounce.

g.text: A is the retained storage-wake button; B is a normal input.

g.desc: A is the retained storage-wake button; B is a normal input.
